_comment: Required status checks on main. 'all' applies to every managed repo; a repo's own list is added to it. Add a repo's CI checks here once its CI exists, never before (a required check that never runs blocks every merge). A check from a reusable workflow in this repo is named '<caller job> / <job>' and goes in 'all' once every repo has the caller (rulesets/repo-lists.json, required_files). 'reads' marks what each required check reads, for Peras to sort a failure (design 7.13 Stage 10): 'pr' (the PR's title, body, author, links or comments, such as a render host bump's before/after: the control plane's to pass, so Peras pauses on its failure rather than patching code), 'diff' (the change only, e.g. a new dependency's licence), 'code' (the code, read on the branch's own commit, its starting commit and main's head) or 'person' (a person's tick, never waited for); verify-settings.py fails while a required check is unmarked or a mark names no required check.
